name: claude-mods
description: Native Claude Code mods: Clawd Radio and Clawd

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:mod
scripts.test:mod: claude plugin test mods/clawd-radio && claude plugin test mods/clawd
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict mods/clawd-radio && claude plugin validate --strict mods/clawd && claude plugin validate --strict .
